description: Q1-grade multi-seed factorial comparison of 4 value-based DQN variants x Prioritized Experience Replay (PER) x Noisy Nets on the VesselEnvV2 graph-navigation MDP. Metrics are REAL (derived from the environment's existing edge attributes); no observation-noise / packet-error / collision / docking / CTE metrics are included because the environment does not implement them.

environment.rationale: The original environment.js is a saturated 2-mission index-advancing benchmark on which all algorithms trivially reach ~100% success / ~119.9 reward with zero between-group variance, making comparative statistics vacuous. V2 reuses the SAME graph topology, SAME edge attributes (distance, risk, traffic, weather, current, travel_time, energy_cost, navigation_cost, difficulty) and the SAME Dijkstra planner, but exposes a genuine graph-navigation MDP where the agent selects among the current node's real outgoing edges. This produces 115 distinct missions/seed, optimal-cost range 5.3-151.5, and a real difficulty gradient (random policy 13% success, near-optimal policy 100%).
environment.mission_distribution: start = any waypoint on an access channel (L02/L08); goal = one of {harbour terminal L01, L02 terminal, L08 terminal}, sampled by a seeded mission RNG (seed+777). Cross-lane routing to the harbour passes through the shared junction.
environment.optimal_reference: Dijkstra over navigation_cost with virtual-edge expansion (identical to environment.js). Validated: a follow-Dijkstra policy yields optimality_ratio = 1.0000 on 100/100 solved episodes, confirming the planner is the true optimum and optimality_ratio >= 1.0 is well defined.

seed_policy: The SAME 10 seeds are used for every configuration (shared/paired design). For a given seed, env_seed = 42 + seed (controls graph + mission stream) and the agent-side RNG is mulberry32(seed*1000003 + 12345) (controls weight init, exploration, replay sampling). This fairness control enables paired statistical tests across configurations on matched seeds.

training.budget_justification: Calibration at 150 train episodes yields a discriminative, non-saturated regime (DQN 58.3+-9.6%, DoubleDQN 67.5+-26.5%, DuelingDQN 26.7+-9.2%, DuelingDoubleDQN 48.3+-28.3% success over 3 seeds) with real between-algorithm and between-seed variance. Random policy = 13%, so no floor effect; best mean ~67%, so no ceiling effect. total_steps_budget scales the epsilon-decay / PER-beta anneal schedule to the training length.

evaluation.policy: greedy (no exploration; Noisy layers still resample noise per action as in the source act() method)
evaluation.rationale: Training-phase metrics conflate exploration noise with policy quality. The converged policy is measured by a held-out greedy evaluation over 40 fresh missions from the same seeded mission stream. These evaluation episodes are the unit of analysis; per-seed aggregates (one scalar per seed) are the independent samples for statistics (n = 10 per configuration).

definitions.success: 1 if the vessel reached the goal within max_episode_steps, else 0.
definitions.steps: Number of environment steps taken in the episode.
definitions.route_cost: Sum of navigation_cost over the edges the agent actually traversed (real edge attribute).
definitions.optimal_cost: Dijkstra minimum navigation_cost from start to goal (real).
definitions.optimality_ratio: route_cost / optimal_cost, over solved episodes (>= 1.0; 1.0 = optimal route).
definitions.route_risk: Sum of the traversed edges' risk attribute (real).
definitions.route_difficulty: Sum of the traversed edges' difficulty attribute (real).
definitions.route_distance: Sum of the traversed edges' geometric distance (real).
definitions.invalid: Count of invalid actions (selected a non-existent edge slot).
definitions.revisit: Count of times the agent re-entered an already-visited node.

explicitly_out_of_scope: packet error rate / communication channel (not implemented; 'PER' in this project = Prioritized Experience Replay, a replay-buffer feature)
collision rate (no vessel dynamics / collision model)
physical travel time (only planner navigation_cost exists)
